title: Define signed review artifact custody
summary: Autonomous workflow artifacts are currently unsigned. The next slice should define a project-key custody contract and add verifier plumbing that can accept signed review artifacts once a public key is approved.
expectedFailureModes: Unsigned review artifacts are treated as release-grade evidence.
Verifier code accepts signatures without binding artifact schema, task id, and commit subject.
Docs choose or expose private key material instead of documenting custody boundaries.
humanEscalation: Human approval is required before selecting, publishing, rotating, or using a project signing key.
nextAction: Design the signed review artifact envelope, add dry-run verifier fixtures, and document key custody inputs without generating or publishing a real project signing key.
